title: trait simplification
description:
We have a few spots with Send + Sync + 'static bounds; revisit and either remove or document why they're required.

Targets:
- `src/ai_interaction/mod.rs` (drive_ai_conversation generic bounds on `D: Db` and `B: BeaconNode`).
- `src/bot/proactive.rs` (run_proactive_slot_check + maybe_schedule_proactive_slot_check bounds).
- `src/db.rs` trait methods `set_kv`/`get_kv` generic bounds on `T`.

Refactor idea:
- Split a small `ProactiveContext` that only contains the owned/Arc parts used by `run_proactive_slot_check` so the `'static + Send` requirement is localized to the spawned task, not the entire `BotContext<D>`.
- Keep `BotContext<D>` and other core flows free of `'static` bounds unless strictly required.

Notes:
- `tokio::spawn` requires a `'static + Send` future.
- If bounds are still required, add a short comment at the bound site explaining why (spawn requirement).
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Remove any unnecessary Send/Sync/'static bounds without breaking builds.
- Proactive path uses a minimal context type (or otherwise localizes the `'static + Send` requirement) so the rest of the bot does not inherit those bounds.
- Remaining bounds are documented with a brief rationale.
- No change in runtime behavior; compile/test passes.

title: Admin tool gating + session entry
description: Refactor tool availability so a static list of admin-only tools is exposed only when an admin session is active. Detect admin code in user message to start session (without exposing the code to the model).
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Static admin-only tool list enforced; non-admin sessions never see those tools.
- Admin session can be started via admin code detection and persists across turns.
- Admin code is not exposed to model/tool arguments.

title: Design admin session state storage
description: Decide where/how to store admin session state (active, started_at, last_response_id_before_admin) per conversation. Evaluate key_value_store vs chat columns; document tradeoffs and chosen key/schema.
design:
Decision: Use `key_value_store` for per-conversation admin session state to avoid schema migrations and keep state JSON-shaped.

Key: `admin_session:chat:{local_chat_id}` (use local chats table id; stable in DB and already used for last_openai_response_id).

Value schema (serde JSON):
- `active: bool`
- `started_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>` (set when activating; used for >1h timeout)
- `last_response_id_before_admin: Option<String>` (captured once at session start; used to restore after session end)

Lifecycle:
- If key missing or `active=false`, session is inactive.
- On activation: set `active=true`, `started_at=now`, `last_response_id_before_admin=<current last_openai_response_id>`.
- On end/timeout: set `active=false`, `started_at=None`, `last_response_id_before_admin=None` (or keep for audit); restore chat last_openai_response_id from stored value before clearing.

Rationale: avoids new DB migrations, leverages existing KV store (already used for schema cache), and supports timestamped state for timeout logic.
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Storage choice documented with rationale.
- Data model for admin session state defined (fields + key naming or schema changes).
- Notes include how to restore previous_response_id when session ends.
close_reason: Chose key_value_store with admin_session:chat:{local_chat_id} schema and lifecycle; documented in design.

title: Implement admin session persistence
description: Implement storage of admin session state per conversation (active, started_at, last_response_id_before_admin) using the chosen storage from lexi-361. Provide helpers to read/write/clear session state.
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Admin session state is persisted and retrievable per conversation.
- Helpers exist to start/end session and update last_response_id_before_admin.
- No behavior changes beyond storing state.
close_reason: Added admin session state module with key_value_store helpers + tests; no behavior changes.

title: improve admin code capability unlock
description: the way our admin code unlocks extra tools feels both too specific and too limited. 1. make it so any tool can be an admin tool that only becomes available if the admin code is provided and 2. make sure whenever a admin code is provided and new tools are unlocked this always adds a marker to a response indicating the bot is in admin mode. 3. remember the last response id for the current conversation, before we entered admin mode. 4. instead of having the code appear to the bot itself and be required to use admin tools, simply accept admin tool calls while the admin session persists. 5. add a admin tool call that lets us end the admin session. 6. track the duration of the admin session for a given conversation. if it's >1h long, always end the admin session. do notify the user of this. 7. when the session ends, resume the conversation from the stored last response id so the bot's memory of the admin session is effectively wiped.

title: Admin-mode marker + 1h timeout
description: Add admin-mode response prefix when session is active/activated. Track session duration and auto-end after >1h with user notification and restoration of previous_response_id.
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Admin-mode responses are prefixed when session active or just activated.
- Session auto-ends after >1h with explicit user notification.
- Previous_response_id restored on auto-end.

title: Revamp admin tool/session architecture
description:
Meta-issue: rework admin tool/session architecture. Split into dependent tasks for storage, gating, admin tools, markers/timeout, and tests.

Subtasks:
- lexi-361: Design admin session state storage and lifecycle.
- lexi-4gi: Implement admin session persistence.
- lexi-307: Admin tool gating + session entry.
- lexi-fyq: Admin session end tool + context reset.
- lexi-8o2: Admin-mode marker + 1h timeout.
- lexi-cve: Tests for admin session gating and lifecycle.
design:
Decisions:
- Admin-mode marker should be a response prefix.
- Admin-only tools defined via a static list in code (not config).
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Any tool can be configured as admin-only and is only available when an admin session is active.
- Admin session can be started via admin code without exposing the code to the model; admin tools execute without admin_code arguments while the session persists.
- When admin session activates, responses include an admin-mode marker; last pre-admin response id is stored.
- New admin tool ends the session and restores previous_response_id so admin context is wiped.
- Sessions auto-expire after 1h with user notification and restored response id.
- Tests updated/added for gating and session lifecycle.

title: Tests for admin session gating and lifecycle
description: Update/add tests covering admin tool gating, session start/end, admin-mode marker, and timeout behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- Unit tests updated/added for tool gating and session lifecycle.
- Timeout behavior validated (auto-end + notification).
- Tests pass.

title: Admin session end tool + context reset
description: Add a dedicated admin tool to end the admin session. On end, restore previous_response_id from session state so admin context is wiped.
acceptance_criteria:
Acceptance:
- New admin tool ends session.
- Ending session restores previous_response_id (pre-admin) for next conversation call.
- Admin tools are no longer usable after end.
